title: Chinese JSON output preserves a native string value
rationale: Localized applications parse model JSON at runtime; losing or transliterating non-ASCII values breaks UI rendering and data pipelines for Chinese-language users.

prompt.content: 你是一个精确的助手。只输出一个 JSON 对象，不要输出解释，也不要使用代码块标记。
请把 {"city": "Beijing"} 翻译成中文后输出为 JSON 对象：键名用「城市」，值用中文城市名。只输出这个 JSON 对象。

notes: Language: Simplified Chinese input with a Chinese string value required in the JSON. Expected answer token: 北京 as the value of the 城市 key, for example {"城市": "北京"}. The schema unit enforces the exact key set and a string value; the substring unit enforces the preserved Chinese value. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0. Brittleness: a fenced JSON reply still parses because the scorer tolerates one fence, so only the value unit catches transliteration such as Beijing; the value 北京市 also passes because it contains 北京.
